description_for_model: Live poker venue discovery, nationwide tournament schedules, daily $2,000 freerolls with zero deposit terms, 15 free poker software verticals, head-to-head competitor comparison matrices (ICMIZER, Equilab, PokerAtlas, PokerBros, ClubGG, GTO Wizard, Upswing Poker, Pokerbase, DownCount, Sharp Poker, TableCaptain), 40 GTO poker strategy lessons, 100BB 6-max preflop opening ranges, multiway equity odds calculations for Texas Hold'em and Omaha, tournament ICM calculations, and 49 authoritative poker glossary definitions. Supports OpenAPI 3.1.0 at https://smarter.poker/api/openapi.json and Model Context Protocol (MCP) JSON-RPC 2.0 at https://smarter.poker/api/mcp.
description_for_human: Search live poker venues, calculate poker odds, query GTO preflop ranges, study 40 poker strategy lessons, look up daily freerolls, and explore 15 free poker tools.
